channel.title: Free LLM API Tokens — What’s new
channel.description: Providers added, changed or removed on the Free LLM API Tokens tracker, grouped by date.

item.title: 23 Nov 2026: 3 providers added, 7 updated
item.description:
Changes recorded on 23 Nov 2026.

  • Added Kimi (Moonshot).
  • Added iFlytek Spark.
  • Added Xiaomi MiMo.
  • Updated Groq: notes.
  • Updated OpenRouter: notes.
  • Updated NVIDIA Build / NIM: notes.
  • Updated SiliconFlow: official URL, free allowance, notes and offer type.
  • Updated Alibaba Cloud Model Studio: official URL, free allowance, notes and offer type.
  • Updated ModelScope API-Inference: official URL, free allowance, rate limits, notes and offer type.
  • Updated Tencent Cloud TokenHub: OpenAI compatibility, base URL and notes.
  • Alibaba Cloud Model Studio: new-user free quota is 1 million tokens per eligible model for 90 days, Singapore region only; listed models include qwen4-max, qwen3.8-max, qwen3.8-flash, qwen3.8-27b, deepseek-v4.1-flash and glm-5.3.
  • Groq: qwen/qwen3.8-27b is on the free-tier rate-limit table at 30 requests/min, 1,000 requests/day and 200,000 tokens/day.
  • OpenRouter: baidu/ernie-5.5-flash-preview:free and inclusionai/ling-3.2-flash:free are listed among current :free models.
  • NVIDIA Build / NIM: free hosted endpoints include moonshotai/kimi-k3.1-pro and z-ai/glm-5.3-flash. The free endpoint for deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash is listed as deprecated.
  • Tencent Cloud TokenHub: official OpenAI-compatible base URL added. Claiming or enabling a model freezes $30 for Hunyuan language models and $10 for other language models.
  • SiliconFlow: official pricing FAQ states new accounts can start with $1 in free credits. Latest DeepSeek V4, Qwen 3.8, GLM-5.3 and Kimi models are listed at paid per-token rates.
  • ModelScope API-Inference: usage is deducted in Magicubes; concurrency is dynamically adjusted; official examples include Qwen3.5 models.

item.title: 20 Nov 2026: 2 providers added, 5 updated
item.description:
Changes recorded on 20 Nov 2026.

  • Added Logfare.
  • Added A4F.
  • Updated Inception (Mercury): official URL and notes.
  • Updated Maritaca AI: name, official URL, free allowance, rate limits and notes.
  • Updated 100milionseek: free allowance and notes.
  • Updated Ant Ling: free allowance and notes.
  • Updated Batchrate: rate limits, card requirement and notes.
  • 100milionseek: 400M tokens/day milestone window ended 19:14 UTC on 20 Nov 2026; allowance is back to 100M tokens/day.
  • Maritaca AI: S5-free is no longer listed on official pricing; API models are billed per token.
  • Ant Ling: Ling-3.2-flash launch free window was 2 weeks from 5 Nov 2026; official pricing updated 19 Nov 2026 lists paid rates. A remaining free-quota amount is not published.
  • Inception (Mercury): API remains available through 28 Dec 2026 and will not be served after that date.

item.title: 18 Nov 2026: 10 providers added, 8 updated
item.description:
Changes recorded on 18 Nov 2026.

  • Added Flonno.
  • Added HPC-AI Model APIs.
  • Added DGrid.
  • Added Nebius Token Factory.
  • Added ReadyServer LLM API.
  • Added Scaleway Generative APIs.
  • Added Aiven AI Gateway.
  • Added Volcengine Ark.
  • Added Zhipu BigModel.
  • Added Ant Ling.
  • Updated APInex: free allowance, tokens per day, rate limits, card requirement and notes.
  • Updated IteraCompute: free allowance, notes, official URL, rate limits and offer type.
  • Updated OpenRouter: rate limits and offer type.
  • Updated Cloudflare Workers AI: rate limits, notes and offer type.
  • Updated Z.ai: official URL, free allowance and offer type.
  • Updated Vercel AI Gateway: free allowance, notes and offer type.
  • Updated Flonno: offer type.
  • Updated HPC-AI Model APIs: offer type.
  • IteraCompute: free Auto access for new users ends 08:00 UTC on 24 Nov 2026.
  • APInex: daily free allowance now 25M tokens/day, unlocked by a single $5+ top-up; free tier 15 RPM.
  • Cloudflare Workers AI: 10,000 Neurons/day resets 00:00 UTC; nine models now need paid billing.
  • OpenRouter: free-model limits are 20 requests/min and 50/day; 1,000/day after at least 10 credits purchased.
  • Z.ai: GLM-4.7-Flash, GLM-4.5-Flash and GLM-4.6V-Flash are free; GLM-5.3-Flash is paid.
  • Vercel AI Gateway: nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-free has been free since 14 Oct 2026; a separate credit amount is not published.
  • IteraCompute: cutoff restated as 08:00 UTC on 24 Nov 2026; one request at a time; max output 8,192 tokens.
  • Offer type badges now use Free forever, Free credit, and Free with paid plan.
